name: @atlasbound/telemetry
description: A daily usage report per module a person chooses: counts, ranges and closed words, every byte shown first. The only package that may use the network.

verbs.what: what the next attempt would post, without closing a day; nothing is sent

help.line: show the state and the exact request the next attempt would post; nothing is sent or written
help.when: before you decide to turn telemetry on

verbs.what: a daily usage report: step counts, ranges and outcome codes, the version, Node major, OS family and a random id; never your code, text, names or paths (every field: PRIVACY.md)

help.when: to read about telemetry and its commands

verbs.what: [module] turn it on for the modules installed now; you type the phrase at your own terminal

help.when: only if you want to send the report to help the product

verbs.what: [module] turn telemetry off, all or one module; anyone may, an AI session too

help.changes: your choice, kept in ~/.atlasbound, and the reports waiting here

verbs.what: on or off per module, why, where reports would go and what waits here

help.line: say whether telemetry is on or off per module, why, and where reports would go

verbs.what: print the exact request the next attempt would post; sends nothing

help.when: to see every byte before it leaves
help.changes: finished days become reports here, and a waiting report that may no longer leave is deleted; nothing leaves

verbs.what: print every report made here, its state and exact bytes

help.when: to see what was made and sent from this repository

verbs.what: [--forget] a new random id; with --forget turn it off, delete what waits here and ask the server to delete what your id sent

help.when: to start a new id, or to have what was sent deleted

flags.--forget: turn telemetry off, delete what waits here and ask the server to delete what your id sent

help.changes: the random id in ~/.atlasbound and the reports waiting here

verbs.what: one attempt now, only for what you turned on

help.line: make one attempt now; the product attempts once a day on its own
help.changes: the reports here leave this machine only when telemetry is on and this build has an address
